summary: Focused claim o-e8c9b676c409c04c (g0010, g0012, g0013, g0014): no harness update is necessary. The old harness can reach the new table cell spoiler behavior.

assessment.necessity_reason: The new behavior is reachable through the existing entry: fuzz input controls both parser flags and the Markdown bytes, and md_html forwards the flags to md_parse. A table cell containing ||x|| with a separate single pipe boundary can exercise it. The output callback discards the result, but reachability satisfies this coverage obligation.

before.requirement: Preserve double pipe spoiler delimiters inside a table cell while using single pipes as cell boundaries.
before.reason: The before collector creates single character pipe marks for table parsing, and the before table pass treats pipe marks as cell boundaries. The spoiler behavior in the frozen tuple was not supported.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete before link content pass has no spoiler resolution step.

after.requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, preserve double pipe spoiler delimiters within a table cell and use single pipes as cell boundaries.
after.reason: The collector makes adjacent pipes one two character spoiler mark. The table pass selects only unresolved one character pipes as boundaries; each cell is then processed through the normal inline path, which resolves spoiler marks. The old harness can supply the flag combination and table text through md_html.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Resolved two character pipe marks produce spoiler span callbacks.
md_html forwards the supplied parser flags to md_parse.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The output callback discards rendered output; the claim concerns behavior reachability.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same table cell spoiler tuple is unavailable before and reachable with the unchanged harness after. Coverage is limited to the supplied focus candidate; this does not establish coverage of every selected change group.
